policies.name: calendar_events_select
policies.using: (is_active() AND ((current_user_role() <> 'danisman'::user_role) OR (gorunurluk = 'herkese_acik'::text) OR (type = ANY (ARRAY['toplanti'::calendar_event_type, 'egitim'::calendar_event_type, 'etkinlik'::calendar_event_type, 'remax_turkiye'::calendar_event_type])) OR is_invited_to_event(id)))

policies.name: event_attendance_insert
policies.with_check:
((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['broker'::user_role, 'owner'::user_role, 'ofis'::user_role])) OR ((user_id = auth.uid()) AND (katilim_tipi = 'istege_bagli'::text) AND (status = 'onayladi'::attendance_status) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM calendar_events ce
  WHERE ((ce.id = event_attendance.event_id) AND ((ce.gorunurluk = 'herkese_acik'::text) OR (ce.type = ANY (ARRAY['toplanti'::calendar_event_type, 'egitim'::calendar_event_type, 'etkinlik'::calendar_event_type, 'remax_turkiye'::calendar_event_type]))))))))

policies.name: event_attendance_select
policies.using: (is_active() AND ((user_id = auth.uid()) OR (current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['broker'::user_role, 'owner'::user_role, 'ofis'::user_role])) OR is_event_creator(event_id)))

policies.name: event_attendance_update_self
policies.with_check: (is_active() AND (user_id = auth.uid()) AND (status = ANY (ARRAY['onayladi'::attendance_status, 'mazeretli'::attendance_status])) AND ((status <> 'mazeretli'::attendance_status) OR (mazeret_status = 'bekliyor'::text)) AND (mazeret_reviewed_by IS NULL) AND (mazeret_reviewed_at IS NULL))

policies.name: opportunities_insert
policies.with_check: ((current_user_role() = ANY (ARRAY['broker'::user_role, 'owner'::user_role, 'ofis'::user_role])) OR ((current_user_role() = 'danisman'::user_role) AND (owner_id = auth.uid()) AND ((claimer_id = auth.uid()) OR (claimer_id IS NULL))))

policies.name: opportunities_select
policies.using:
(is_active() AND ((owner_id = auth.uid()) OR (claimer_id = auth.uid()) OR ((claimer_id IS NULL) AND (status = 'acik'::opportunity_status)) OR (current_user_role() = 'broker'::user_role) OR ((current_user_role() = 'owner'::user_role) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM users u
  WHERE ((u.id = COALESCE(opportunities.claimer_id, opportunities.owner_id)) AND (u.rol = 'broker'::user_role))))))))

policies.name: opportunity_interest_insert
policies.with_check:
(is_active() AND (user_id = auth.uid()) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM opportunities o
  WHERE ((o.id = opportunity_interest.opportunity_id) AND (o.status = 'acik'::opportunity_status) AND (o.owner_id <> auth.uid())))))

policies.name: opportunity_interest_select
policies.using:
(is_active() AND (is_manager() OR (user_id = auth.uid()) OR (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM opportunities o
  WHERE ((o.id = opportunity_interest.opportunity_id) AND (o.owner_id = auth.uid()))))))

policies.name: tasks_select
policies.using: (is_active() AND ((assignee_id = auth.uid()) OR (created_by = auth.uid()) OR is_manager()))
